title: Capacity setup canvas and annotated screenshot variants for Dedicated onboarding
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a set of annotated, production-ready screenshots and a canvas flow for the Dedicated onboarding flow that covers initial capacity setup, autoscaling policy selection, and SLA expectations. Deliverables include: (1) a step-by-step canvas showing the recommended defaults for burst vs steady workloads, (2) three annotated screenshot variants (Minimal, Balanced, High-availability) for use in docs and in-app quickstart, and (3) microcopy proposals for inline help and tooltips explaining cost/performance trade-offs.
design_notes: Canvas should be presented as progressive steps: Select pool size -> Add autoscale policy -> Configure fallback models -> Review SLA and cost estimate
Provide two visual density versions of screenshots: compact list view for docs and expanded panel view for in-app modal
Include a heatmap overlay mock for expected utilization (10th/50th/95th percentile) to illustrate steady vs burst patterns
Microcopy tone: concise, action-oriented; include a one-line risk/cost summary in the review step
Use color tokens consistent with Console 2024 styles; avoid red/green as primary indicators — use accent + iconography to indicate risk/impact
Accessibility: ensure text sizes in overlays meet AA contrast; provide alt text strings for each screenshot in assets manifest
tradeoffs: Embedding the utilization heatmap increases cognitive load in the first-pass modal; opted to show a simplified summary with an expandable details panel
Providing prefilled capacity recommendations (e.g., 2x baseline) reduces setup friction but may under-provision for high-tail workloads; added a clear link to advanced sizing guide
High-fidelity animated prototypes would better convey autoscale behavior but increase handoff time; chosen static annotated frames + short GIF for autoscale timeline
acceptance_criteria: Three screenshot variants exported at 2x and 3x resolutions and uploaded to Drive
Figma frames finalized with naming convention: Onboarding / Capacity / Minimal | Balanced | HA
Microcopy strings compiled in the Console copy doc and approved by PM
Design review documented with at least two engineering and one PM sign-off
Assets include: PNG/JPEG, SVG icons used, and alt text for each image
reviewer_feedback: PM (Riley Torres): Prefer conservative defaults for enterprise customers; add explicit 'estimated monthly cost' line in review step
Eng (Nina Alvarez): Need exported assets to match the component grid (360/720 breakpoints); will add a small CSS shim for the modal preview
Design Lead (Omar Singh): Approve visuals pending microcopy tweaks (reduce sentence length in tooltip to 90 chars)
QA (Leo Martin): Request for test IDs on each overlay element for integration tests
next_steps: Finalize microcopy and push to docs PR (owner: PM)
Export PNGs @2x and @3x to Drive and add manifest.json with alt text
Create short GIF demonstrating autoscale reaction to 10x burst and add to in-app quickstart
Schedule handoff sync with ENG leads (Nina, Sam) for 2025-03-06
